# Sailnet

> A rewarded privacy network paid in XNO: relays carry onion-routed circuits over ordinary-looking HTTPS and are paid per megabyte, directly, on the Nano ledger.

No token, no accounts, no company in the middle. All text below is taken from the project README, which is the authoritative source.

## What Sailnet is

- [README](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md): Run a relay on any VPS or home PC and earn XNO to a wallet you control. Use the network from the Android app, the desktop apps (SOCKS5 proxy and DNS for any browser), or the Chrome and Firefox extensions. Censorship resistance: bridges, WebSocket-shaped tunnels, measured traffic shaping.
- [README (简体中文)](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese translation of the README; the English README is authoritative.
- [How it works](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#how-it-works): A client builds a telescoping multi-hop circuit (two to four relays, three by default). The entry sees the client, the exit sees the destination, nobody sees both.

## Run a relay and be paid in XNO

- [Run a relay in one command](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#run-a-relay-in-one-command): `--payout nano_…` is the address your earnings are sent to, and it is the one decision you should make before you start the relay rather than after. With `--payout` set, everything above a small operating float is swept out every 15 minutes to a wallet you already control.
- [Run a relay, ride it free](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#run-a-relay-ride-it-free): If you run a relay, your own app uses it without paying.
- [Upgrading](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#upgrading): Upgrading is optional. A relay that never upgrades keeps working, keeps being chosen for circuits, and keeps earning.
- [Releases](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/releases): `sailnode` and `sail` for Linux (x86-64 and arm64), the desktop apps for macOS and Windows, the Android APK and the Chrome and Firefox extensions, each with a `.sha256` beside it. Docker images are on GitHub Container Registry as `ghcr.io/dhyabi2/sailnet`.

## Use the network

- [Use the network](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#use-the-network): The client makes a wallet on first run and claims a free trial grant for it, so the first circuit costs nothing. Android: install the APK from Releases; the app funds itself the same way and shows where to get XNO.
- [Desktop apps](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#desktop-apps): The macOS, Windows and Linux client serves a SOCKS5 proxy on 127.0.0.1:1080 and DNS on 127.0.0.1:5300 for browsers and the extension.
- [Browser extensions](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#browser-extensions): A proxy toggle that points the browser at the local client's SOCKS5 port with remote DNS, a WebRTC leak guard, and the live circuit status.

## Warnings

- [Your wallet, and backing it up](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#your-wallet-and-backing-it-up): A relay's earnings and a client's balance live in one secret: a 32-byte seed in `wallet.json`. Nobody else has a copy. There is no account to recover and no support address that can give it back. So write it down.
- [Without --payout](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#run-a-relay-in-one-command): Destroy the VPS, lose the disk, or rebuild the box without exporting that seed, and the money is gone, permanently, and nobody can give it back.
- [Privacy limits, stated plainly](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#how-it-works): Sailnet cannot hide the device's MAC address or hostname on the local network, or the funding graph of a wallet on the public ledger; fund relay and client wallets from an exchange if they must not be linkable to you.
- [Built to be hard to censor](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#built-to-be-hard-to-censor): Nothing here has been measured from inside a censored network yet.
- [Upgrading the app](https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet/blob/main/README.md#upgrading-the-app): Android, one-time reinstall: moving to v0.2.53 needs an uninstall and a fresh install, once. Back up your seed first if the wallet holds anything you want to keep; uninstalling deletes it.
